contents.potioneer.introduction: Humans must depend upon a variety of potions to travel the path of supreme ascension. Each pathway begins at sequence 9, and the lower one descends, the stronger they become, rivaling even the Gods themselves. This is but a short introduction to the hidden world of Beyonders.
contents.potioneer.formula_top: Firstly, you'll want to get yourself acquainted with a fitting sequence 9 potion formula.
contents.potioneer.formula_bottom: Search far and wide for one that speaks to you. There are many sequence 9 potions.
contents.potioneer.cauldron_top: Once you have chosen to concoct a potion, you must create a dedicated potion cauldron.
contents.potioneer.cauldron_bottom: Make sure you use the right proportions of water, and light a fire beneath if needed. Getting the recipe wrong could be disastrous.
contents.potioneer.pathway: There are plenty of pathways out there, and each one converges to their own level of power. Each one is unique, however, I have noticed that many share similar abilities at some levels...
contents.potioneer.ingredients: A formula's ingredients are broken down into 2 sections: main and supplementary. The resulting potion depends only on the main ingredients, but it can only be fully concocted with the supplementary ingredients combined. There is, however, a way to concoct a potion if you don't have access to the main ingredients...
contents.potioneer.spirituality: Beyonders cast abilities by consuming their spirituality. This is detrimental on the spirit, and lowers their sanity if they overexert themselves, but nothing a simple day-long rest won't fix. You can recuperate spirituality via Cogitation, but only time can heal the mental strain.
contents.potioneer.sanity: Beyonders are guardians, but also a bunch of miserable wretches, constantly fighting against dangers and madness. Their sanity is limited by the digestion of their characteristics, and if it's low enough they'll start taking damage.
contents.potioneer.acting: "You don't 'grasp' potions, you digest them. Nor is it about 'discovery' but acting. A potion's name is not only symbolic, it is also Imagery. When digesting potions, it's key."
contents.potioneer.advancing: To advance, you must consume a potion of the following level to yours, but it must be of the same pathway as the one where you started. Attempting to 'switch' pathways will only result in immediately losing control and dying.
contents.potioneer.mistakes: It is possible to consume a potion and skip levels, though incredibly foolish and dangerous. If you have found yourself in this predicament, you won't feel as mentally well as you might hope for, but to fix that it's as simple as consuming the missing potions you skipped, you doofus.
contents.characteristic.potioneer: When a Beyonder dies, they have a chance of dropping one or more of their characteristics. These can be used as replaced for the main ingredients of a potion formula. Generally, you'll drop your last characteristic if you die with low sanity.
contents.potioneer.lady_fate:
Honorific name:
%s

Lady Fate is the Goddess who symbolizes Fate, Time and Infinity. Despite not being considered an orthodox deity, few would regard "Her" as evil.
contents.potioneer.luck_charm_top: The Temporary Luck charm is most suited for battle. When cast, it will grant the target with generally positive luck for a while
contents.potioneer.instant_luck_charm_to: The Instant luck charm is most suited for quick spurts of great luck. When cast, it will grant the target with a significant amount of luck, but it won't last much time.
contents.potioneer.cooldown_charm_top: An aggressive charm that will be sure to annoy your opponents. When cast, it will randomly put the target's abilities on cooldown, based on their luck.
contents.potioneer.patience_charm_top: The patience charm is luck in a bottle. When cast, it will make the target unlucky for a moment, before granting plenty of luck later.
contents.potioneer.velocity_charm_top: The patience charm is time in a bottle. When cast, it will immediately make the target move and attack faster. Great for disorienting.
contents.potioneer.gambling_charm_top: Use this one wisely, for it can be useless and useful at the same time. When cast, it will, based on the luck of the target, make them stronger or weaker.
contents.potioneer.luck_effect_charm_top: A charm to grant your allies with the partial dominion over the luck effects. Dodging, arrow deviation, all the nice stuff.
contents.potioneer.instant_bad_luck_char: The Instant bad luck charm can be used to immediately lower someone's immediate luck value.
contents.potioneer.bad_luck_charm_top: This charm can lower the luck range of someone for the duration of the effect.
contents.potioneer.fate_charm_top: The fate charm is one of the most sought after by fools who think themselves lucky. It doesn't guarantee good events will come, but it is guaranteed to attract something...
contents.potioneer.chaotic_luck_charm_to: When used on someone, increases their odds of triggering a luck event by 300% compared to their base chance.
contents.potioneer.water_affinity_charm_: A water affinity charm can be used to help your allies. When cast, grants the target with 30 seconds of water affinity for every base item used.
contents.potioneer.water_prison_charm_to: This charm, when cast, will apply the water prison effect on the target. They will rendered unable to leave bodies of water for 10 seconds per base item used.
contents.potioneer.king_of_heroes:
Honorific name:
%s

The King of Heroes is a God who symbolizes Order, Chaos and Tyranny. One of the three orthodox deities, "He" is quite particular about his followers.
contents.potioneer.rituals_candles_top: In a ritual, the amount of candles dictates what existences you are targeting and how many.
contents.potioneer.rituals_candles_botto: One candle to target oneself, another to contact another existence, and a third one to specify a victim. Even so, it's always safer to not rely on hidden existences.
contents.potioneer.rituals_ink_top: When performing a ritual, you must place ritualistic ink around the altar and pedestals to mark the area.
contents.potioneer.rituals_ink_bottom: It must form a closed area around the altar, and every pedestal inside will be counted in the offerings.
contents.potioneer.rituals_dagger_top: A Ritualistic Dagger is a basic tool that doubles as a ritual trigger and as a weapon.
contents.potioneer.rituals_dagger_bottom: It forms a barrier of spirituality, tracing the ink placed down, allowing you to communicate with your desired target.
contents.potioneer.rituals_offerings_top: If you have any possessions to offer up, place them in pedestals within the ritual area.
contents.potioneer.rituals_offerings_bot: They'll serve as recipient for ingredients, but be warned, for these offerings can be used to attract certain existences.
contents.potioneer.charm_101:
To craft charms, you simply do a ritual to the proper existence. If their powers allow for it, and they so desire, it'll be crafted.
 Each charm is made up of a base material and up to 6 different decorations. The quantity of base material determines the duration of the associated effect, while the reputation with and level of the target existence determines the level of the effect.
contents.potioneer.appraisal: The appraisal ability lets you see a lot of previously hidden information. Things like the pathway of an item, the downsides of an artifact, or whether a potion was correctly made, can be determined with just a glance. Alternatively, you can also use coins to divine potion concoction success.
contents.potioneer.coin_divination_top: Coin divination is the simplest kind of divination. One needs no special mystical knowledge to leverage its powers.
contents.potioneer.coin_divination_botto: Simply put the item you wish to divine in your off-hand, and flip a coin with your main one. Heads means 'yes', tails means 'no'.
contents.potioneer.rod_divination_top: Rod Divination is one of the more intricate divination methods. It rests on the assumption that one's spirituality is tuned enough to their target.
contents.potioneer.rod_divination_bottom: Interacting with a placed rod will cause it to fall, and depending on one's spirituality, or dare I say luck, it'll point you a location of interest...
contents.potioneer.dream_divination_top: This is the most passive of all divinations. When a seer goes to bed, they'll randomly dream of information from the spirit world.
contents.potioneer.dream_divination_bott: What they say and when they trigger is dependent on the level of the seer, on the day, and on the seer themselves. Controlling dream divination is a fool's errand, but they do divine items in your inventory.
contents.potioneer.map_divination_top: Map Divination might be the best way to locate a bunch of items at once. If a seer knows the general area of their target, they can splash ink onto the map to locate them.
contents.potioneer.map_divination_bottom: Simply hold the map in your main hand, the target of your divination on your offhand, and some ritualistic ink in your inventory, and cast the ability to do map divination.
contents.potioneer.luck: Luck as a concept is impossible to predict, but it does follow rules. Firstly, it is always changing. Every second it goes up or down randomly. But it never leaves someone's 'luck range' naturally, so you'll generally find it sitting between their minimum and maximum values. Certain mystical phenomena can suppress this range, maxing it at 0, making the person unlucky.
contents.potioneer.luck_range: A luck range can be interpreted as someone's affinity to Fate. It is compromised of a maximum and minimum values, which are calculated based on the person's luck position. If their position rises 50 levels, then both their maximum and minimum rise 50 levels too. Their instant luck fluctuates randomly overtime within this range, and if it is outside the range, it'll slowly walk back inside. Knowing how to affect one's luck range is crucial to tamper with Fate.

short_desc.potioneer.cogitation: Your essence... your being... this is what makes you
long_desc.potioneer.cogitation: Concentrate your spirituality and recuperate in a safe place.
characteristic.potioneer.corrupt: Your %s has been corrupted by a characteristic
short_desc.potioneer.zero_damage_1: It's not really zero damage, more like 'maybe' damage.
long_desc.potioneer.zero_damage_1: Based on your luck, tools in your hand will not lose durability.
short_desc.potioneer.zero_damage_2: Now it lives up to the name... kinda?
long_desc.potioneer.zero_damage_2: Tools in your hand will not lose any durability.
short_desc.potioneer.zero_damage_3: Zero is an absolute with no boundaries
long_desc.potioneer.zero_damage_3: Tools in your inventory do not take damage. Block placement can also be randomly refunded.
short_desc.potioneer.miner_light_1: Why have this ability? You can already see in the dark.
long_desc.potioneer.miner_light_1: Light Block. I- what do you want me to say here?
short_desc.potioneer.miner_light_2: Light was born from infinity. I was there to see it.
long_desc.potioneer.miner_light_2: Light Block. Nothing changed, but the description is more interesting.
long_desc.potioneer.void_vision: You gain the ability to see in the dark.
short_desc.potioneer.pick: A humble friend is always at your beck and call.
long_desc.potioneer.pick: Store a pickaxe item, and recreate it whenever you want.
short_desc.potioneer.mining_1: "No amount of speed is enough to break infinity"
short_desc.potioneer.mining_2: Time is only as valuable as you make it.
long_desc.potioneer.mining_2: You can customize the mining speed bonus.
short_desc.potioneer.wheel_knowledge: As your friend, I recommend reading this book.
long_desc.potioneer.wheel_knowledge: Check your book! You gain mystical knowledge when advancing.
short_desc.potioneer.silk: I once used this to gather ores for my garden.
long_desc.potioneer.silk: While active, you can mine blocks with silk touch.
short_desc.potioneer.fortune: Greed is overrated. But freebies are freebies...
long_desc.potioneer.fortune: Based on your luck, you can get a greater yield per ore.
short_desc.potioneer.calamity_1: I almost forgot this was the reason I stopped using artifacts.
long_desc.potioneer.calamity_1: The more artifacts you have, the lower your luck tends to be.
short_desc.potioneer.calamity_2: You'll have to learn to accept Fate's blessings.
long_desc.potioneer.calamity_2: Artifacts lower your luck, and you trigger events more often.
long_desc.potioneer.calamity_3: When hit, a third of recorded damage will be dealt as thorns damage
short_desc.potioneer.target_appraisal_1: No, it doesn't read someone's mind. I can confirm.
long_desc.potioneer.target_appraisal_1: You can see the stats and luck of anyone you look at.
short_desc.potioneer.target_appraisal_2: You still can't read people's minds.
long_desc.potioneer.target_appraisal_2: You can appraise someone if you have a bit of their spirituality.
short_desc.potioneer.block_appraisal: I once used this to find ores for my garden.
long_desc.potioneer.block_appraisal: L-Click to to find ores in your hand, R-Click count ores around you
short_desc.potioneer.appraisal: My followers thought me omniscient, but I just saw through their lies.
long_desc.potioneer.appraisal: Lets you study objects in detail
short_desc.potioneer.patience_1: Given enough time, you can manipulate fate in your favour.
long_desc.potioneer.patience_1: Temporarily attract more calamities to you to get luck in the future.
short_desc.potioneer.patience_2: You are immune to the immediate downsides of fate's machinations.
long_desc.potioneer.patience_2: Patience doesn't reset your luck to 0 anymore.
short_desc.potioneer.velocity: You become nimble, in both form and function.
long_desc.potioneer.velocity: Customize movement speed with R-Click and attack speed with L-Click.
short_desc.potioneer.w_bone_meal: Speed is a construct to abstract away that which takes time
short_desc.potioneer.aoe_cooldown: Manipulating someone's perception of time is as simple as being hit.
long_desc.potioneer.aoe_cooldown: When attacked or when you L-Click, put random abilities on cooldown, including on you.
long_desc.potioneer.gambling_1: When cast, makes you either stronger or weaker, based on your luck.
short_desc.potioneer.gambling_2: Draw from the infinity, and achieve the impossible
long_desc.potioneer.gambling_2: When gambling, your spirituality either becomes 0 or infinity.
short_desc.potioneer.wheel_divination: Fate and luck go hand in hand, it's only natural that you pry into its secrets.
long_desc.potioneer.wheel_divination: Luck based divination is more prone to succeed.
short_desc.potioneer.fate: Fate and Destiny themselves becomes one of the few things you can control
long_desc.potioneer.fate: You can cast luck events, and know about them ahead of time.
short_desc.potioneer.luck: Your fighting style becomes much more chaotic and fine tuned to luck.
long_desc.potioneer.luck: Randomly, you can dodge attacks or deal crit hits. Crit can Crit ad nauseam.
short_desc.potioneer.half_cooldown: Even the temporal limitations of your abilities can be meddled with
long_desc.potioneer.half_cooldown: When cast, halves all current cooldowns.
short_desc.potioneer.refresh_cooldown: The allies you so desire can also receive from the pot.
long_desc.potioneer.refresh_cooldown: Fully resets cooldown for you and your allies.
short_desc.potioneer.phasing: The dominion over probability and zero, in the palm of your hand.
long_desc.potioneer.phasing: You can phase through blocks while active.
long_desc.potioneer.bet: Sacrifice all luck to succeed in gambling.
short_desc.potioneer.damage_recording: Delay what hurts, and give back tenfold.
long_desc.potioneer.damage_recording: L-Click to record damage taken, R-Click to dish it out. Crouch to see stored damage.
short_desc.potioneer.misfortune: As the source of all that is hated, you alone can guide the battle.
long_desc.potioneer.misfortune: You can cast immediate or general bad luck on a target..
short_desc.potioneer.water_affinity_1: To build an empire, one must start with the first stone.
long_desc.potioneer.water_affinity_1: You get a natural affinity to underwater travel.
short_desc.potioneer.water_affinity_2: One must also be able to break any unruly stones.
short_desc.potioneer.scales: To become agile in water, a King must develop thick skin.
long_desc.potioneer.scales: Passive armor, and while underwater, consume spirituality to heal.
short_desc.potioneer.ocean_order: The denizens of the deep won't dare to hurt you.
long_desc.potioneer.ocean_order: Underwater monsters won't start fights with you.
short_desc.potioneer.tyrant_divination: Knowledge is power of a ruler.
long_desc.potioneer.tyrant_divination: You get basic access to divination [WIP].
short_desc.potioneer.water_spell: Controlling your domain is the first step towards a kingdom.
long_desc.potioneer.water_spell: Offers a plethora of water-based spells
short_desc.potioneer.water_spell_1: Everything is fair in war, even crimes.
long_desc.potioneer.water_spell_1: Conjure a water trap, in air or water. It detonates when non-allies get too close, applying its effects on them.
short_desc.potioneer.water_spell_2: The most haunting spell I know of.
long_desc.potioneer.water_spell_2: Create a water block around your targets' head, taking their oxygen, slowing them down, and obscuring their vision.
short_desc.potioneer.water_spell_3: The biggest mistake one can make is to fight by another's rules.
long_desc.potioneer.water_spell_3: Cast a spell that pushes enemies down when trying to leave a body of water.
short_desc.potioneer.water_spell_4: Controlling a crowd is the same as controlling the battle.
long_desc.potioneer.water_spell_4: Cast to apply continuous knockback on enemies.
short_desc.potioneer.water_spell_5: A king only lasts while your people agree with you.
long_desc.potioneer.water_spell_5: Can create and absorb water. Absorption will regenerate some health.
short_desc.potioneer.water_spell_6: Once the war is over, let the people wander the lands and seas.
long_desc.potioneer.water_spell_6: Cast while looking at a mine to refund some spirituality.
short_desc.potioneer.water_spell_7: A cohort is only whole by anchoring to a Leader.
long_desc.potioneer.water_spell_7: Heal nearby allies, at the cost of some of your own health. Damage scales with amount of allies healed.
short_desc.potioneer.contract_give: The order of the world is for the Tyrant to leverage.
long_desc.potioneer.contract_give: You can write up a contract, for yourself or another ally. Grant a permanent buff for as long as the condition chosen is met.
short_desc.potioneer.contract_view: A look into the contract you signed.
long_desc.potioneer.contract_view: View the details of the contract applied to you
short_desc.potioneer.air_bullet: Surprise your enemies with a well timed gun shot
long_desc.potioneer.air_bullet: Shoot an air bullet from your mouth. It pierces targets. Damage scales with sequence.
short_desc.potioneer.door_opening: Open a door through any obstacle in your way
long_desc.potioneer.door_opening: Lets you teleport to the other side of any obstacle. Teleport distance scales with sequence.
